name: What Remains After Love Burns Out
original_name: What Remains After Love Burns Out
overview: After a car accident, Ernesto Pérez loses all memories of Lorena Ortega, the woman he has loved for seven years. Daniel Ortega—Ernesto’s best friend, who has been by his side throughout his recovery—soon realizes that Ernesto truly does not remember Lorena. This marks a turning point for Ernesto, who had been quietly courting her all that time, unaware that Lorena’s heart still belongs to her ex-boyfriend.
